# temps_shield_settings (Resource)

Platform-wide Shield settings.

Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are; it only stops managing them.

Import with `shield_settings`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_shield_settings" "this" {
  share_observations = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `share_observations` (Boolean) Share anonymised abuse observations to improve shared blocklists.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `shield_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_shield_settings.this shield_settings
```
